capabilities: Chat with the vault using locally retrieved Markdown snippets
Show cited snippets and note paths for each answer
Save local chat history with source snapshots
Review, edit, and confirm memory drafts before reuse
Configure any compatible model service, including local models
extras: README notes that the synthesized model flow on desktop macOS is verified, but real-service answer quality and mobile behavior are unverified; detailed usage and privacy docs live outside the README. Model services may require an account or incur costs.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to query your notes conversationally with the answer's sources kept visible and verifiable.
summary: Read-only AI chat plugin that answers questions from your Markdown vault with cited sources and user-approved memories.
